import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.buffer.read().split()
    n = int(data[0]); m = int(data[1]); x1 = int(data[2])
    A = [0]*m; B = [0]*m; S = [0]*m; T = [0]*m
    pos = 3
    for i in range(m):
        A[i] = int(data[pos]) - 1
        B[i] = int(data[pos+1]) - 1
        S[i] = int(data[pos+2])
        T[i] = int(data[pos+3])
        pos += 4
    X = [0]*m
    X[0] = x1
    NEG = -(10**19)
    best = [NEG]*n
    # events: (time, type, idx); type 0 = arrival (processed first at equal time), 1 = query
    events = []
    for i in range(m):
        events.append((T[i], 0, i))
        if i != 0:
            events.append((S[i], 1, i))
    events.sort()
    for t, typ, i in events:
        if typ == 0:
            v = X[i] + T[i]
            c = B[i]
            if v > best[c]:
                best[c] = v
        else:
            v = best[A[i]] - S[i]
            X[i] = v if v > 0 else 0
    sys.stdout.write(" ".join(map(str, X[1:])) + "\n")
